title: Counting the Takings

readiness.math: counting in fives (older: tens); equal groups
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: What a busy morning! The cash box is full of coins, all jumbled. Let's count them.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The easy way is to make little piles of five. Then we count the piles: five, ten, fifteen!

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Make piles of five coins. Count as you go: one, two, three, four, five.
steps.hint: Find a pile with an empty dip, and put a coin there.

older.prompt: Make piles of ten coins this time. There are no dips: count them yourself.

feedback.full: That pile has its {n}. Start another pile.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Now I know just what we have, and I can give a share to the poor box, like I always do. Thank you!

journal_line: I counted Mr. Tobias's coins in piles with him.
unavailable_text: The coins are counted for today.
